description: This file defines the `BaseEventListener` interface in the `com.icontrol.event` package. It serves as a placeholder or marker interface for event listeners that want to be notified of events, which are subclasses of `BaseEvent`. The interface is currently empty and is intended to be used with generated code for specific event listener implementations.

classes.name: BaseEventListener
classes.description: Interface for Listeners to implement that wish to be notified of events as they occur. It is a marker interface with no methods defined.
